text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an Arima Kinen crowded with Senior Year 
Umamusume, Manhattan Cafe put on a 
magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O likened Manhattan Cafe to 
"Leckermoul's companion," leaving everyone 
wondering what that could mean...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, it seemed her "friend" had 
pulled even further ahead, leaving 
Manhattan Cafe in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Darkness dwelt in Manhattan Cafe's eyes as 
she pursued it, and her hooves screamed in 
pain. Harboring a grim premonition, she 
headed into the Tenno Sho (Spring).
